notes.title: Fran Bow 2.0 Plushie
notes.content:
“Will the Fran Bow plushie come back?” 
“I missed the campaign for the Fran Bow plushie!” 
The community has spoken! 
With the help of Makeships time machine, Fran Bow plushie has traveled through time. And is now back for another limited-time campaign and is 200% ready for snuggles! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9582121/de87da05e606c68732e149f12f50ff1ef96a4107.png[/img]
[i]The second edition plushie will have a small marking to differentiate it from the first edition. The marking will state the plushie as a second-edition production. The design of the plushie is the same as the first edition. [/i]

[b]How the campaign works:[/b]
[list]
[*] Makeship launches the campaign on their site. 
[*] During a limited time, the fans can support the campaign.
[*] If the campaign gets 100% funded, the plushie is guaranteed for production but if a campaign doesn't reach 100% during the campaign time, the supporters get their money back. 
[/list]
[b]Support the campaign in the hopes of getting your own Fran Bow plushie.[/b]
[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/fran-2-0-plushie]https://www.makeship.com/products/fran-2-0-plushie[/url]
After the campaign ends, the plushies will not be available for purchase.

Your support means the world to us, and we can't wait to see the plushies finding new homes and bringing joy to fans worldwide. Let's make this campaign a fantastic success together!

Peace and love, out happy! 
[b]Killmonday Games [/b]

notes.title: Fran Bow physical copy - Switch edition!
notes.content:
Hello Sweeties!

We are so excited to share the news with you! 
Fran Bow physical edition for Nintendo Switch is here! 🎉

Only 3000 copies will be available worldwide for purchase. 

Unbox the madness inside! 💊

[b]The physical copy bundle will include: [/b]
- Fully assembled game cartridge of Fran Bow with tons of creepy adventures!
- Spooky interior art.
- A little book with exclusive content about the F.R.E.E 🗝️
- Exclusive SRG sticker
- Pack of 3 collectible trading cards. 👁️

[url=https://superraregames.com/products/srg-105-fran-bow-switch]BUY IT HERE[/url]

Trading cards
There is a total of 5 trading cards you can collect. You get 3 random cards if you buy the physical copy bundle of the game. If you like to collect all 5 of the trading cards you can buy extra booster packs in the hope of completing your collection.

The 5th full art card is rare and is the only shiny card out of the 5. These appear in 1 out of 6 packs.

[url=https://superraregames.com/products/tc-105-fran-bow-trading-card-booster-pack]BUY THE BOOSTER PACK HERE[/url]

We appreciate your support and opinions! 💖
If you buy the physical copy please share it with us! 🥰
Tag us @killmondaygames on our social media platforms! ⭐

notes.title: FRAN BOW VINYL FIGURE PETITION
notes.content:
For a long time, many of you have asked if we ever are going to do figurines of [b]Fran Bow![/b] And now this dream could become a reality!

As we previously worked with Makeship on a couple of plushies, we got an opportunity to run this petition, to see if we, together with you guys, could make a vinyl figure happen.

[b]But before we can start[/b], we need 500 people to pledge for the Fran Bow figurine in order to get the design and production going!  

[url=https://www.makeship.com/petitions/fran-bow-vinyl-figure style=button]LINK TO THE PETITION[/url]

[h1]THE PROCESS[/h1]

[h2]THE PETITION PHASE[/h2]
[list]
[*]During this week (7 days) starting today 13 Nov 2023 20:00 CET we will have a petition for the vinyl figure [url=https://www.makeship.com/petitions/fran-bow-vinyl-figure]HERE[/url]. If you would like a vinyl figure of Fran Bow you can pledge for the petition
[*] One pledge is $2 USD and we need 500 for the petition to be a success. You can pledge up to 5 times, meaning 5 x $2 USD
[*] If the petition fails, you will get the money you pledged back. 
[*]When you pledge you will also need to pre-authorize a future payment for the vinyl figure, note that the total amount of times you pledge equals the amount of figures you will buy when the campaign launches. (See example down below) 
[/list]
[h2]THE CAMPAIGN PHASE[/h2]
[list]
[*] If we reach the petition goal after these 7 days. We will start the design process of the vinyl figure. 
[*] When the design process is done a campaign (like the plushie campaigns) will launch on Makeship. The new vinyl figure campaign will launch fully funded.
[*] When the campaign launches we will announce it on our social media, here on Steam and in our newsletter. 
[*] If you have pledged the vinyl figure during the petition phase, you will now be charged the retail price ($ 29.99 USD + shipping and tax fees) on the same day the vinyl figure campaign goes live on Makeship! You will also get the petition deposit as a discount on your order.
[/list]
[h3]EXAMPLE: [/h3]
You have made 3 pledges during the petition (3 x $2 USD = $6 USD) you will then be charged for 3 pieces of the Vinyl figure when the campaign launches at Makeship. (3 x $29,99 USD + shipping and tax fees) but also get a discount of $2 USD for each figure on your order which is the Petition Deposit you previously made. 

[b]We hope this opportunity sounds as exciting for you as it is for us! Let’s make this happen![/b]

notes.title: Fran Bow Update
notes.content:
What does this update include?

We are finally done with moving Fran Bow from Gamemaker to Unity in order to release the game to Xbox, Nintendo Switch and Playstation! 

This means that you will now have an option to either start the original “vanilla” version of Fran Bow or the updated new version.

The new version includes tons of updates compared to the original!

[list]
[*] Controller support
[*] Manual save slots
[*] Remastered music & sound
[*] Additional animations 
[*] Added French and Brazilian Portuguese localization
[*] Added 64-bit support for mac
[/list]

notes.title: Fran Bow hotfix!
notes.content:
Hello dear adventurers!

We have released a quick update to fix the startup problem that many experienced with a recent steam client update and it should be solved now!

We have also taken away the beta branches since now you can make minor adjustments yourself in the options.ini file in case you are having troubles with the game and we will provide a guide on how to do that.

In case you are still unable to open the game by various reasons, make sure you are not in a beta branch!

To make changes in how the game starts, you can now try different methods easily in the options.ini file that lives in the game folder!

How to find the options file:
1. Right click Fran Bow in your library and choose properties
2. Go to LOCAL FILES and click BROWSE LOCAL FILES
3. Find the file called "options.ini" and open it
4. Follow the intructions mentioned there!

Since we had to revert to an older version of steam api, Fran Bow might "crash" when you exit the game but this won't affect anything so don't worry :)

notes.title: Fran Bow Update #3
notes.content:
Hello awesome adventurers!

We have been trying out a beta patch that helps to get rid of the biggest issues in Fran Bow.
We got great feedback from the players who tried the patch so we decided to make it available for everyone.

Fixes done:

[b]* Initial loading is a lot faster, graphics are only loaded when needed.
* More compatible to older machines and graphic cards. White boxes should dissapear with this update.
*NOTE: If you are experiencing a slow gameplay, go to "Options  and choose Shaders OFF.[/b]

Have a great day and we hope you can enjoy Fran Bow now! <3
Best whishes,
/Killmonday Games.

notes.title: Fran Bow Update #2
notes.content:
Hello lovely adventurers! <3

We have been into an amazing journey after the release of Fran Bow.
We thank everyone that has been writing lovely e-mails and sending us feedback and how you feel about the game.
You are super precious to us! <3

We present to you, some of the things we have been working on these past week: 


[b]Major changes[/b]

[list]
    [*]You can now choose between different resolutions 
([b]Note: The game was drawn originally at 854x480[/b])
    [*]You can turn on and off the shaders during pill mode
    [*]V-sync on and off
    [*]You can now double click on doors and windows for faster navigation
    [*]Added in one more achievement
[/list]

[b]Minor fixes[/b]

[list]
    [*]Fixed the feather bug in chapter 2 part 1
    [*]A song would overlap another one in chapter 3 when you entered the bar during spring
    [*]Typos in English and German languages
[/list]

[b]IMPORTANT NOTE:[/b]
In case you need to reset everything back to the original settings, press F10 in main menu.

For the players who still experience white textures, please check our FAQ 
https://franbowgame.wordpress.com/gamer-support/faq/ 

[b]Fran Bow Original Soundtrack available on Steam! [/b]http://store.steampowered.com/app/404840/


Thank you for your support!
Many hugs and shiny kittens to you!

Natalia and Isak 
(KillmondayGames)

notes.title: Fran Bow first patch and thank you!
notes.content:
Hello, mysterious adventurers!

You might have noticed two updates on Fran Bow after the release day, and now we will tell you what's going on!

So this post-release patch has fixed these issues:

* A ton of Minor glitches fixed
* A crash found in chapter 1 and another in chapter 3
* Missing text in the bar in chapter 3 
* Sound fixes

If you are experiencing the Loading screen error, that it won't progress after a long long time, we are still screaming at the computers on that. However, you can try this:

If your computer has two graphic cards you can switch between, try the other one! This has solved it for a some people. We don't have the opportunity to test this ourselves unfortunately.

If you see a lot of white textures / boxes, switching to your other graphic card will solve this too! Especially if you are using INTEL CHIPSET CARDS! 

You can also try right-clicking on Fran Bow in your library, selecting properties and then in the SET LAUNCH OPTIONS try one of these:

-intel or -vanillagfx or -software

These can aid you too!

Hope some of these tricks can help you experience the Fran Bow journey! Thank you all for the nice words! We are doing our best to be here for you all!

Additional note!
"so for anyone with an nvidia driver; they can open their nvidia configuration panel, go to "manage 3d settings" and choose "High Performance Integrated Graphics" could help with loading screen too!

Best regards,
Natalia & Isak
